cards.name: Asheville Sport Fencing Summer Camps
cards.description: Campers learn Olympic fencing with equipment provided. Beginner sessions require no experience; intermediate sessions are intended for fencers with at least a month of previous experience.

season.text: Registration for our 2027 summer camps is not open yet. Dates, pricing and sign-up will be announced in the spring.

hours.text: Camps typically run 9am to 3pm, Monday through Friday.

extended_care.cost_text: Early drop-off and late pick-up have been available for an extra fee by request.

lunch.text: Our 2026 camps were $475 for the week, including lunch and snacks.

cards.review_notes: Hours are described as typical, and extended care as historically available, rather than confirmed for 2027. Lunch and prices describe 2026 only. The equipment guide generically says owning gear is required for camps, while the summer camp page explicitly provides equipment for both beginner and intermediate camps; the program-specific wording was used. The statement that both 2026 camps filled up is historical and was not treated as current availability.
